payload.description: Open the private local Revolut/Lunar balance and transaction preview. Reuse data for 6 hours, otherwise fetch read-only through the Oracle backend and rebuild the preview. No import into PersonalHub, no payments or transfers. Registration does not grant execution permission.
prerequisites: Fedora desktop session with ph-banche installed and a browser available
Existing oracle-vm SSH access and authorised Enable Banking backend sessions
Installed Data runtime for refreshing the private local preview
